fact_text: Dolmen City REIT owns Dolmen Mall Clifton in Karachi and the Harbour Front office building next to it.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Other Dolmen malls, including the Lahore mall and the Tariq Road and north Karachi malls, are not owned by Dolmen City REIT.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mall occupancy stays high because tenants queue for space when a lease ends, which gives the owner pricing power on rents.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mall tenant leases include a clause for a fixed rent increase of 10% each year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: About 90% of mall rent is fixed, while the remaining 5 to 10% has moved to revenue sharing with some tenants, including Khaadi and the food court.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Revenue sharing gives upside if retail sales boom, but the revenue-share portion is small, so overall rent growth stays modest.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mall rental income was about PKR 2 billion in FY16.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Harbour Front rental income was about PKR 540 million in FY16.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The property management fee is roughly 7 to 8% of rent each year and is the company's largest expense.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The REIT management fee is about 3% of rent and is the second-largest expense.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Profit growth has outpaced rent growth because management keeps expenses under tight control, which the analyst sees as a key strength.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The company announces quarterly dividends for minority holders as soon as a quarter ends, before its accounts are finalised.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In 2021 the company stated that no tenant contract had been terminated early up to that point.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Engro leases almost half of the Harbour Front building, with Synergic and Philip Morris also among its office tenants.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Construction of Sky Tower A and B next to Harbour Front, planned as hotel apartments, could raise the location's value and lift rents if it succeeds.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The main risk is losing its position as Karachi's number one mall to rival projects such as Emaar or the Bahria Icon Tower in 7 to 10 years.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The listed REIT is priced on dividend yield against bank deposit rates, so its share price can sit far below the underlying property value.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: On the PSX, dividend-paying companies are usually given a fair value based on dividend yield.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A REIT that distributes 90% of its rent pays no tax on that rental income, and the dividends it pays out are taxed at 15%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Future budgets can raise the REIT dividend tax to 25%, which is a policy risk for REIT holders.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Weighted average lease expiry measures how long a REIT's tenant contracts run on average, and shows how stable its rental income is.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Invest in Real Estate via Stock Market - Dolmen City REIT' (YouTube transcript, undated)
